annotations.title: List TollNode models and data tools

description: Free. Lists every TollNode tool (AI models for images, video, voice and music, plus live data) with a one-line summary, its price per call, price options and accepted parameters. Filter by category (e.g. Image, Video, Audio, Search, Social) or a search word. Then call the tool by its name.

category.description: Only this category, e.g. Image, Video, Audio, Search, Social, Shopping, Business.

search.description: Only tools whose name, title or summary contains this text, e.g. 'upscale' or 'youtube'.
